response.rationale: A and B describe the same capability: recording honey harvests with checks on treatment withdrawal periods. Both are anchored on the same class, HarvestService (node e4a0a62f13370a5f). A also brings in its persistence collaborator, HarvestRepository. The withdrawal checks are worded differently, "treatment withdrawal safety" in A and "food-safety withdrawal checks" in B, but they mean the same thing. The difference in scope comes from how each was grouped (a community in A, a component in B), not from a different business function.
